items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: So, a friend of ours, he wasn't a musician, but he's a lover of music. He's a bummer, whatever, see. His name was Albert Hudson.

ctx.x: No, I mean, he could talk to a father. I mean, he's got the job to go to.

Well, let me tell you this deal right now, quick. Yeah, okay, quick. We're women, hey, you know. But I mean, you can get something to him. I think this is really funny. To me it is. Because it's natural, see. We were back there, see. At the Almond State in Minnesota. In those days, I never heard of a horrible Almond. They took it out of the bottle, see. You can have a bottle in the pocket. Oh, man, I drink it up and throw it by the same theater in the lobby there. Same place right there. So, I mean, there's never…
That could have been Guy Kelly or Chris Kelly.
